label: Bible Study
prompt: _____ are better than one; because they have a good reward for their labour.
verse: Two are better than one; because they have a good reward for their labour.
note: The Preacher's case for teamwork — and a couple verses later, a cord of three strands.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: For my yoke is easy, and my burden is _____.
verse: For my yoke is easy, and my burden is light.
note: The closing line of Jesus's 'Come unto me' invitation: His yoke fits, and His burden is light.

label: Sunday School
prompt: The _____ that I left at Troas with Carpus, when thou comest, bring with thee, and the books, but especially the parchments.
verse: The cloke that I left at Troas with Carpus, when thou comest, bring with thee, and the books, but especially the parchments.
note: Even apostles forget things: Paul asks Timothy to bring the cloke he left at Troas, plus the books and parchments.

label: Deep Water
prompt: And by the river upon the bank thereof, on this side and on that side, shall grow all trees for meat, whose leaf shall not fade, neither shall the fruit thereof be consumed: it shall bring forth new fruit according to his months, because their waters they issued out of the sanctuary: and the fruit thereof shall be for meat, and the leaf thereof for _____.
verse: And by the river upon the bank thereof, on this side and on that side, shall grow all trees for meat, whose leaf shall not fade, neither shall the fruit thereof be consumed: it shall bring forth new fruit according to his months, because their waters they issued out of the sanctuary: and the fruit thereof shall be for meat, and the leaf thereof for medicine.
note: The river flowing from Ezekiel's visionary temple grows trees with healing leaves — Revelation 22 echoes it.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: And Moses said unto the LORD, O my Lord, I am not _____, neither heretofore, nor since thou hast spoken unto thy servant: but I am slow of speech, and of a slow tongue.
verse: And Moses said unto the LORD, O my Lord, I am not eloquent, neither heretofore, nor since thou hast spoken unto thy servant: but I am slow of speech, and of a slow tongue.
note: Moses' excuse at the bush: 'I am not eloquent' — and God answered, 'Who hath made man's mouth?' (4:11).
